summary: # Introduction to New Features in Marvelous Designer 12.1 ## Background Image Addition In Marvelous Designer 12.1, you can now drag the background image into the background. The image can be added to the 2D window background directly from the Resource Manager as a background image. ## Window Layout Shortcuts To enhance your workflow, use the shortcut to switch window layouts. Press the **LW** key to zoom in on the selected window. Press **LW** again to return to the original layout. ## Display Statistics You can view various information related to clothing through the display statistics feature. For more detailed information, please refer to our operation manual. ## USD File Integration with Omniverse Connector The integration with the USD file format allows for improved cooperation efficiency with multiple 3D software. By using the USD file format, data interaction is achieved on the Omniverse platform, making the cooperation process smoother and faster. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching!
